This investigation looks at the connections between the rectangles made by dividing one rectangle into two
•• the length of a rectangle is always longer than its width
•• the length and width of a rectangle are always a whole number of units
•• the scale factor of any enlargement is greater than 1.

text: A rectangle is cut into two smaller rectangles, A and B.
When B is an enlargement of A, the original rectangle is called a scale-rectangle.
length A B width B width
A 4 by 10 rectangle is cut as shown.
length of A 4 width of A 2
So B is an enlargement of A with scale factor 2.
This means that the rectangle with dimensions 4 by 10 is a scale-rectangle with a factor of 2.
